metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 8 (best for NDSI calculation with SWIR band) - Dates: Multiple Decembers from 2005-2015 (comparison), plus December 2020 - Location: Mount Fuji, Japan (approximately 35.36°N, 138.73°E) - Geometry: Define as a point or small polygon around Mount Fuji 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is essential for accurate NDSI (snow/ice index) - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) - For Landsat 8: Band 3 (Green), Band 6 (SWIR) - For Landsat 5/7 (2005-2015): Band 2 (Green), Band 5 (SWIR) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check image count for each December period - Check pixel count after cloud masking - Validate NDSI range (-1 to 1) - Compare mean NDSI values across all Decembers - Answer "Yes" if 2020 is lower than ALL Decembers 2005-2015 - Answer "No" if 2020 is higher than at least one December 2005-2015 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Fuji location const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.73, 35.36]); const bufferRegion = mountFuji.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // Function to calculate NDSI and filter clouds function calculateNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B6']).rename('NDSI'); const cloudMask = image.select('BQA').lt(2720); // Mask clouds return ndsi.updateMask(cloudMask).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); } // Collect NDSI for each December 2005-2015 const decemberNDSI = []; let allValidMonths = 0; for (let year = 2005; year <= 2015; year++) { const startDate = `${year}-12-01`; const endDate = `${year}-12-31`; let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bufferRegion); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if Landsat 5 not available if (col.size().getInfo() === 0) { col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bufferRegion); } const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size > 0) { const ndsiCol = col.map(calculateNDSI); const meanNDSI = ndsiCol.select('NDSI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.first(), bufferRegion, 300, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const pixelCount = ndsiCol.select('NDSI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.count()) .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.first(), bufferRegion, 300, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('count').getInfo(); if (pixelCount > 0 && meanNDSI !== null && !isNaN(meanNDSI)) { decemberNDSI.push(meanNDSI); allValidMonths++; print(`Dec ${year}: NDSI=${meanNDSI.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${pixelCount}`); } else { print(`Dec ${year}: No valid pixels`); } } else { print(`Dec ${year}: Images=0`); } } // Get December 2020 NDSI const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate('2020-12-01', '2020-12-31') .filterBounds(bufferRegion); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); if (size2020 === 0) { print("Dec 2020: Images=0"); print("C1"); return; } const ndsiCol2020 = col2020.map(calculateNDSI); const meanNDSI2020 = ndsiCol2020.select('NDSI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()) .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.first(), bufferRegion, 300, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const pixelCount2020 = ndsiCol2020.select('NDSI') .reduce(ee.Reducer.count()) .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.first(), bufferRegion, 300, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('count').getInfo(); if (pixelCount2020 === 0) { print("Dec 2020: No valid pixels"); print("C2"); return; } if (meanNDSI2020 === null || isNaN(meanNDSI2020) || meanNDSI2020 < -1 || meanNDSI2020 > 1) { print("Dec 2020: Invalid NDSI value"); print("C3"); return; } print(`Dec 2020: NDSI=${meanNDSI2020.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${pixelCount2020}`); if (allValidMonths === 0) { print("No valid comparison data"); print("C1"); return; } // Check if 2020 is lower than ALL Decembers 2005-2015 const isLowerThanAll = decemberNDSI.every(val => meanNDSI2020 < val); print(`Valid comparisons: ${allValidMonths}`); print(`Min(2005-2015)=${Math.min(...decemberNDSI).toFixed(3)}`); if (isLowerThanAll) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
